narrow.title: The Studio needs a screen at least 1024 px wide

history.errorFileChanged: File {{file}} was modified externally, cannot undo this step

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Changes at once, without reloading. Remembered for every project on this computer.
settings.themeHelp: System follows the light or dark setting of this computer. The project page in the Canvas keeps its own colours.
settings.editorHelp: "Open in editor" jumps to the file and line of the selected element in this editor.
settings.packageManagerHelp: Installs the dependencies of a project KumiCraft creates. An existing project keeps its own.
settings.agentPreferredHelp: Auto chooses the ready assistant. You can also pick a fixed one.
settings.loginSessions: Several sign-in sessions on the Canvas
settings.loginSessionsHelp: Shows a "Sign-in" picker on the Canvas toolbar. Each session keeps its own sign-in, for apps where you need two roles at once (for example customer and farmer). Off: the Canvas uses one sign-in.

aboutPage.description: A visual design space built right on your real source code. Select an element on the Canvas and edit it directly. Every change is written straight into your source files.

edit.title: Visual editing
edit.body: Layout, spacing, type, images, effects. Drag-and-drop blocks

devices.title: Many devices
devices.body: Desktop, Tablet and Mobile at once, sign-in kept

ai.title: AI agents
ai.body: Work with Claude Code, Antigravity CLI

styles.title: Supported styles
styles.body: Tailwind 3/4, CSS, CSS Modules, Sass/Less, Bootstrap

aboutPage.platforms: React + Vite · Express + Pug (view mode) · Runs locally on 127.0.0.1, no account needed
aboutPage.author: Designed and built by
aboutPage.tagline: A more direct way to build interfaces.

trust.bar: This project is not trusted: its dev server, dependency installs and AI agents do not run. You can still look around.
trust.title: Do you trust this project?
trust.intro: Running a project runs its own code: the Vite configuration, its plugins and its dependencies. Trust only projects you know.
trust.restricted: Until you trust it, KumiCraft does not start its dev server, install its dependencies or run an AI agent on it.
trust.backends: Linked backends (the AI agent reads a read-only copy)
trust.backendOutside: Outside the folder that holds the project, check carefully

project.notProject: This folder holds other files, not a Vite + React project. To create a new project, click "+ New project…" above.
project.styleNotEditable: Visual styling: not supported for this system yet, use AI to change styling
project.styleUnsupportedInspector: Visual styling is not supported for {{system}} yet. Select an element and ask AI in the AI tab.

reasons.noVite: Project does not include Vite in dependencies
reasons.noReact: Project does not include React in dependencies
reasons.noTailwind: Project does not include Tailwind CSS
reasons.craUnsupported: Create React App has been deprecated by React (2025). KumiCraft 1.0 supports React + Vite; migrating to Vite is recommended by React.
reasons.nextUnsupported: Next.js is not yet supported in KumiCraft 1.0, planned for 1.1.
reasons.webpackUnsupported: React projects with custom webpack configuration are not yet supported; KumiCraft 1.0 supports React + Vite.

install.title: Install dependencies
install.description: Dependencies need to be installed before the dev server can run.

backends.title: Project backends
backends.confirmRemove: Unlink this backend? Its code is not deleted.
backends.intro: Link the folder of your backend code (for example ASP.NET Core, Express or Laravel) to this project. When you ask the AI assistant to build the UI, it reads the backend to learn which API routes exist and what data they return. KumiCraft only reads a copy and never changes the backend code.

devPort.title: Port of the web page on the Canvas
devPort.hint: Leave it empty for most projects: KumiCraft runs the page on the same port as npm run dev. Enter a port only when your backend accepts API calls from one specific address (CORS settings), for example 3000 for http://localhost:3000. Saving restarts the page on the Canvas.
devPort.invalid: The port must be a number from 1024 to 65535, or empty

designDirs.title: Where new files go
designDirs.hint: When you create a page, layout or component in KumiCraft, the new file goes in the first folder of that group. Folders added below it are still read for the lists. Paths are relative to the project root.
designDirs.newCssDir: Folder for new CSS files (empty: next to the component file)
designDirs.moveUp: Move to the top (new files go here)

project.folderNameInvalid: A folder name cannot contain / \ : * ? " < > | or end with a dot or a space.
project.willCreateAt: The project will be created in:

project.locationMissing: The location folder was not found. Click Browse… to pick an existing folder.
project.emptyFolder: Empty folder: create a project right here

errors.sourceConflict: Source file was modified externally, reloaded

borders.mixedSides: The sides differ: give them the same value and they merge into all 4 sides
borders.mixedCorners: The corners differ: give them the same value and they merge into all 4 corners

inspector.invalidValue: Not a valid Tailwind {{major}} value: for example 4, 2.5, 1/2 or [13px]
inspector.darkSetupAiPrompt: Add dark mode to the page {{file}} (route {{route}}). Change colors only in this file and the components only it uses; do not edit other pages. How: if the project already has a light/dark mechanism (a store, ThemeProvider, next-themes, data-theme, a dark class…), reuse it and do not add a second one; if it has none, use a dark class on <html> (follow the system setting at first, remember the visitor's choice, add a no-flash snippet to index.html). If the project has no light/dark button yet, put one on this page. Do not install packages.

screen.stateHint: States (hover, focus…) and dark mode always apply to all screens

screen.cannotSplit: Can't set this screen on its own: this frame is too close to the next one, with no screen breakpoint between them.
screen.viewing: Viewing {{frame}}: changes apply to all screens.
